newsitem.title: USA: NJ Resources cleared to market electricity.
newsitem.headline: NJ Resources cleared to market electricity.

text.p: New Jersey Resources Corp said on Thursday the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission had approved an application by the company's energy marketing subsidiary to engage in wholesale electric power transactions as a marketer of electricity and related energy services.
The approval allows the subsidiary, New Jersey Natural Energy Co, to add wholesale electric services to its existing mix of services for customers in New Jersey and elsewhere.
The subsidiary already provides services such as natural gas sales, fuel purchasing, pipeline capacity management and overall energy portfolio management to wholesale customers in 17 states.
"Through our fuel management alliance with GPU Inc, we established our initial position in the electric market. This approval will allow us to build on that foundation," New Jersey Resources said.

With the FERC authorization, the company can arrange transactions between utility or non-utility power generators and such wholesalers as municipal utilities or other electric utilities. It can also aggregate generation sources and match various production, transmission and pricing provisions with wholesale customer needs.
